reuse.why: Calls the shared worstCaseAmount from shared/rules.ts that the forecast, schedules app and budget template already use for the range rule.

duplication.why: The missing/number/range dispatch around worstCaseAmount is written again in a private getExpectedAmount, the fourth copy of the dispatch already inlined in schedules/app.ts (twice) and forecast-schedules.ts, rather than extracted into a shared function.

placement.why: The API projection is computed in scheduleModel.toExternal, the API-model layer, with the rule delegated to shared/rules.ts; the dispatch would better live next to worstCaseAmount.

scope.why: Limited to the API model, the handler type, a test and a release note; introducing APIScheduleListEntity keeps create/update input types untouched.

maintainability.why: Clean and typed; the remaining risk is that the 0-for-missing and number cases are re-decided locally like at the other sites.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses worstCaseAmount, the tree's shared range rule

disguised_duplication.where: api-models.ts getExpectedAmount re-expresses the inline 'amount == null ? 0 : number ? amount : worstCaseAmount(...)' dispatch of schedules/app.ts as a private named function
